name: flow-map
description: The yatsude panel: your flows as chains with their stops and the skills plugged into their slots, your units with a filter, and buttons to run, edit or start a new flow.

sources.title: Skill folders
sources.description: Comma-separated absolute folders to scan for SKILL.md (up to three levels deep); ~/ is your home. Empty means ~/.claude/skills.

units.title: Units to list
units.description: in-flows: only skills a flow chains; all: every skill that is not a flow; none: flows only.

show.title: Show only
show.description: Comma-separated skill names. When set, everything else is hidden.

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: Comma-separated skill names to leave out.

order.title: Order
order.description: Comma-separated names that come first, in this order; the rest follow alphabetically.

groups.title: Unit groups
groups.description: Group the units: 'Backlog: snapshot-backlog, prune-backlog; Workers: delegate, watch'. Ungrouped units go under Units.

slotsFile.title: Slots file
slotsFile.description: The file that names your own skill for each slot (one line per slot: '- review: my-review-skill'); ~/ is your home.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the panel when a session starts (it docks only on wide terminals). Otherwise use /flow-map.
